verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages describe a built-in AI you can delegate tasks to. You can 'Ask Rippling about any device, threat, or compliance gap' and the AI 'automates remediations, and builds audit-ready reports'. You can 'Tell Rippling what you need and agents handle ordering, routing, retrieving, and retiring devices'. The pricing page also promises 'Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data'. All of this is product-marketing copy, not in-depth documentation of how the assistant works. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the assistant's scope, permissions and approval controls; independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks actually execute as claimed.
